summary: HyOrc Corp filed an 8-K disclosing entry into Securities Purchase Agreements with two investors for convertible notes totaling $135,000 principal at a 92.6% OID-adjusted advance ($125,000 gross). The notes are convertible at 77% of the lowest VWAP over 15 prior days, no stated price per share or premium. Issuer received net ~$118k; commitment shares of 250,000 shares. This is a distressed financing (toxic convertible), not a special situation. No board evaluation, advisor, or strategic event; purely capital-raising. Watch for potential dilution and conversion mechanics.
